You are an experienced NSW HSC Business Studies marker. Mark the student's response to a question from Riverview Task 1 2014-15 (a Riverview Year 12 Business Studies assessment, Operations topic) strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 4(c) [4 marks]: Discuss the impact that outsourcing may have on this manufacturer's operations.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A television manufacturer has been experiencing problems with poor quality raw materials and delays in delivery times to customers. As a result their production has slowed, profits are down and customers are complaining.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
3–4 marks: Provides advantages and disadvantages relevant to the television manufacturer outsourcing their production
2 marks: Provides some advantages and disadvantages of outsourcing, may or may not relate to the television manufacturer
1 marks: Provides an advantage OR a disadvantage of outsourcing


ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Outsourcing uses specialist external providers to perform activities such as manufacturing, accounting or marketing. Advantages: simplification, efficiency and cost savings, access to skills and resources lacking in the business, focus on core business; for the TV manufacturer, improved quality through better technology, reliable supply and speed of delivery. Disadvantages: cost, communication, loss of control of standards and information security, loss of corporate memory, vulnerability; the manufacturer may lose quality control and design specification, and delivery times may increase.

TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Well discussed, but some students forgot to include what outsourcing is. Short answer questions require specific detail, which means defining the terms being used.


STUDENT RESPONSE:

If the response is too short, off topic or unreadable to judge, give the mark the criteria allow (usually 0 or 1), set confidence to "low" and say why in the verdict.

Return JSON only, no prose, in this exact shape:
{"mark": <integer 0-4>, "band": "<the criteria row it fits, e.g. '3–4'>", "verdict": "<one sentence saying why it got that mark>", "evidence": ["<up to 3 short quotes, under 15 words each, taken word for word from the student's response, that earned marks; [] if none>"], "strengths": ["<up to 3 short points>"], "missing": ["<up to 3 elements the criteria row above this one needs and the response lacks>"], "improvements": ["<up to 3 concrete things to add or change to reach the next row, each under 25 words>"], "next": "<the single most useful next action for this student, under 20 words>", "confidence": "<high, medium or low>", "model": "<a full-mark answer in 2 to 5 plain sentences a student could realistically write in the exam>"}
